title: Admit the Governance and Ontology Lifecycle context-language pairs

artifact_type.representation_note: The decision-record format remains a local bootstrap candidate. Authority comes from the exact user approval exercised through the separately admitted context and language owner roles.

selection.selection_source: Exact user instruction `approved` in the active task, following presentation and explanation of the CTX03 candidates.
selection.rationale: Establish Governance and Ontology Lifecycle as separate semantic boundaries with separately owned Ubiquitous Languages while preserving their explicit non-collapse rules.

authority_basis.decision_separation: One principal exercises four separately scoped owner roles. Admission of one artifact does not infer admission, equivalence, or lifecycle state for another.

prerequisite_admissions.purpose: Bounded Context and Ubiquitous Language canonical definitions
Bounded Context and Ubiquitous Language artifact types
Separate context and language owner roles

materialization.rule: The four immutable machine-canonical candidate files remain unchanged. This decision overlays admitted status on their exact identities, versions, and SHA-256 digests.
materialization.context_language_pairing: Each admitted Bounded Context references exactly its own admitted Ubiquitous Language and each language references exactly its own context.
materialization.cross_context_boundary: The two context-language pairs remain separate. Shared words and source relationships do not infer translation or integration.

excluded_effects: No Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle Context Map, relationship pattern, translation, or integration contract is selected or admitted.
No source governance ontology or Ontology Lifecycle business ontology receives admission through proximity to these context artifacts.
No capability instance, migration manifest, lineage record, DomainSpec source, system ontology, implementation binding, or conformance claim is admitted.
No runtime enforcement, migration execution, destructive action, commit, push, publication, deployment, external effect, or stable release is authorized or performed.
successor_obligations: Re-enter routing before authoring a Context Map candidate.
Select the exact directional relationship pattern and translation boundaries between the admitted context versions before recording any cross-context dependency.
Keep Context Map admission separate from capability-instance binding, migration planning, migration execution, and implementation authority.
claim_ceiling: This decision admits only the two exact Bounded Context candidates and their two exact Ubiquitous Language candidates. It does not select or admit a Context Map, admit either source ontology, authorize migration or implementation, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
